cover.prompt: On the rampart terrace of slope post 4, bandit-1 stands at a 3/4 angle chiseling consensus tally marks onto a flat wooden beam mounted to the wall, his arms held high and clear of his ribcage so bright daylight illuminates his silhouette; bandit-3 in saffron orange tunic descends a flight of stone steps in an exaggerated wide stride, carrying a sealed leather message case held away from his thigh; a dressed ashlar lintel and doorpost anchor the right frame margin; beyond the parapet the morning sea shines far below, while crisp diagonal lighting carves sharp geometric shadows across the limestone walls and paved ground.
cover.others: a small wooden cage with carrier pigeons resting on the bench.
